name: succession-and-forced-heirship-compared
description: Compares forced heirship (reserved shares for children and spouse) and inheritance tax on death across France, Italy, Spain, Germany, Switzerland, Malta, the UK, the UAE and the US, for a family planning who gets what and what it costs. Covers who is caught (residence, domicile, situs), child and spouse allowances, the UK long-term residence test, Spain's regional override, and why a trust, foundation or move does not end a reserved share or an old country's tax.
